name: Ōtoyo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōtoyo town emblem in navy: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtoyo, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 29 July 1964.

features.role: Ōtoyo town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain of two peaks
